rederived_oracles.method: Independently derived beta_feed = wrap(beta_mech + eta*psi + nu*alt) and beta_squint = wrap(beta_feed + pi/2) from Section 4.1/4.2.1 text (own mount-factor table: fixed/equatorial=(0,0), alt-az=(1,0), nasmyth-r=(1,1), nasmyth-l=(1,-1); own Rodrigues rotation about a_p = sin(beta_squint) N - cos(beta_squint) E). For fixed, alt-az (boresight_altitude_rad=1.0, boresight_parallactic_rad=0.7, supplied directly to the public BeamSystem.evaluate_jones keyword arguments), and alt-az+nasmyth-r (altitude=0.6, parallactic=-0.4) with a uniform circular-aperture analytic beam (14 m) and positive_native_feed='y', predicted the displaced response centre and located production's actual peak of |E_00| via a SciPy Nelder-Mead search over (altitude_rad, azimuth_rad) starting from that prediction. Confirmed the search is non-trivial by also starting from zenith and from the opposite-sign (wrong) prediction: both converge to the same true peak, 0.0698 rad (2x the 2 deg feed offset) away from the wrong-sign prediction, so the recovered peak is a genuine, discriminating location rather than the optimizer echoing its start. observed is the max small-angle angular separation between predicted and located centres across the three mount cases.

Independently built C = M(basis) @ R(chi) from Section 4.2.1's formulas (own matrices, not radiosim.core.jones.receptor). Sampled b_plus/b_minus from a squint-FREE plain BeamSystem's scalar evaluate_jones at MY OWN Rodrigues-rotated displaced directions (rotating the off-boresight probe direction itself, not the boresight, by my own R(-sign*delta; a_p)), for a rotated-linear fixture (chi=27.3 deg, positive_native_feed='x') and a circular fixture (chi=15 deg, positive_native_feed='r'), both at 170 MHz against a 150 MHz reference offset of 2 deg. Computed my own expected = C^dagger @ diag(b0,b1) @ C and compared entrywise to the composed E returned by the squint-enabled production BeamSystem.evaluate_jones at the same probe direction and matching boresight_parallactic_rad=0.0/boresight_altitude_rad=pi/2. For the circular case also independently verified the Section 4.2 identity E == (b0+b1)/2 * I2 - (b0-b1)/2 * sigma_y and exact commutation with a real rotation R(0.9 rad). Also cross-checked, using only the b_plus/b_minus values already stored in the retained extended_precision_native_feed_factorization evidence row (a circular, chi=0 case), that my own closed-form (b0+b1)/2 and (b0-b1)/2 reproduce the row's recorded expected.maximum_abs (0.5700171390542352) and expected.minimum_abs (0.2573210780036615) exactly, as internal-consistency authentication of that complex256 row (see accepted_limitations). observed is the max of the four residuals (linear factorization, circular factorization, circular identity, circular commutation).

Reused the rotated-linear fixture above (chi=27.3 deg, positive_native_feed='x', 170 MHz) to obtain production's composed E (from squint-enabled BeamSystem.evaluate_jones) and my own independently sampled b0, b1 (own Rodrigues-rotated directions, own scalar samples from the squint-free BeamSystem). Built my own C = M(linear) @ R(chi) and a nontrivial real rotation P = R(1.234 rad) using jones/parallactic.py's documented but independently-transcribed R(a) = [[cos a, sin a], [-sin a, cos a]] form (a pure algebraic choice, not tied to real sky geometry). Computed CEP = C @ E @ P, DbCP = diag(b0,b1) @ C @ P, and CPE = C @ P @ E with plain NumPy matrix products. Verified inside this method that |CEP - CPE|_max = 0.0855, which is >= 1e-3 (the Section 8.1 order-matters separation bound), confirming the two orders are measurably different for this rotated-linear fixture. observed is max|CEP - DbCP|.

Independently transcribed the exact Cotton/Uson law delta(nu) = asin[(nu_ref/nu) sin(delta_ref)] and the small-angle limit from Section 4.1. For a fixed-mount, uniform circular-aperture fixture (mechanical angle 35 deg, per-feed reference offset 2 deg at 150 MHz, positive_native_feed='y') evaluated at four frequencies (100, 150, 200, 240 MHz), located production's actual response peak via a SciPy Nelder-Mead search on |E_00| at each frequency (search seeded at my own arcsine-law prediction) and recovered the offset as the angular separation between the located peak and the zenith boresight -- an independent, peak-finding measurement, not a read-back of production's internal delta(nu). observed is the max abs difference between the recovered offset and my own exact arcsine-law prediction across the four frequencies. Also confirmed the small-angle approximation is distinguishable from both the exact law and the recovered offset: at 240 MHz (furthest from the 150 MHz reference) the small-angle law differs from the exact law by 2.70e-6 rad and from the recovered offset by 2.70e-6 rad, both roughly 1900x the observed peak-finding residual.

review_checks.method: Read code (not summaries): public entry point is radiosim.api.simulator.Simulator (setup()/run()), which resolves self._receptor_set (resolve_receptors) before self._beam_system = load_beam_system(..., receptors=self._receptor_set) (src/radiosim/api/simulator.py lines ~486-565), then passes both self._beam_system and self.receptors (the same resolved set) into RIMESimulator.calculate_visibilities, which reaches _build_jones_chain in core/visibility.py. There, _resolved_receptor_terms(instrument, receptors) builds the chain's C term from that same receptor set, and a private _ResolvedBeamJones adapter wraps beam_system.evaluate_jones as the chain's E term -- the final composition site is BeamSystem.evaluate_jones / _evaluate_squinted_response in core/beam/runtime.py, which builds C internally from the identical resolved basis/feed_rotation_rad. core/visibility_healpix.py imports and reuses the same _build_jones_chain (grep-confirmed single call site), so there is exactly one beam pathway for both solvers, and load_beam_system( has exactly one production call site (api/simulator.py). git diff b6d09b7..5c94d92 -- src/radiosim/core/contraction.py is empty.

review_checks.observed_outcome: public entry point Simulator; final E composition site BeamSystem.evaluate_jones in core/beam/runtime.py; one beam pathway shared by both solvers; the same ResolvedReceptorSet feeds C and E; no contraction-signature change

accepted_limitations: Bit-for-bit reproduction of the exact scientific_sha256/raw_cube_sha256 strings stored in the evidence's fingerprint_diff rows was not attempted, because those digests are sensitive to host-specific absolute tmp_path bytes baked into config provenance; instead the default_disabled_fingerprints check independently reran the squint-absent workload twice on this host and confirmed the two runs agree byte-for-byte, which is the invariant those evidence rows assert.

Extended-width (complex256) evidence rows (native_feed_factorizations case_id extended_precision_native_feed_factorization) were authenticated for internal consistency -- independently recomputing (b0+b1)/2 and (b0-b1)/2 in float64 from the row's own recorded b_plus/b_minus values and matching the row's recorded expected.maximum_abs/minimum_abs exactly -- rather than re-executed at complex256 width on this reviewer's arm64 macOS host, whose NumPy longdouble/clongdouble alias float64/complex128 (finfo(longdouble).nmant == 52), following the SCI-005 Stage-1 A1 precedent.

The alt-az and Nasmyth-right cases of the mechanical_feed_rotation oracle supplied boresight_parallactic_rad/boresight_altitude_rad directly as keyword arguments to the public BeamSystem.evaluate_jones surface rather than deriving them from a configured beams.pointing block through the private per-antenna boresight adapter in core/visibility.py (_ResolvedBeamJones._boresight_pair); that adapter's own pointing-offset-to-boresight geometry is pre-existing WP-7 machinery outside Stage 2's scope and was not independently re-derived here.

The mechanical_feed_rotation and squint_frequency_law oracles located production's response peak with a bounded numerical optimizer (SciPy Nelder-Mead); recorded observed residuals (~1.3e-9 rad and ~1.4e-9 rad) reflect that optimizer's convergence floor rather than an exact closed-form comparison, and the fixed_limit values (1e-6 rad) carry margin above that floor rather than certifying agreement to machine precision.

This review's four rederived_oracles and six review_checks are the Section 8.2 required set; they do not re-derive every row of the retained Stage-2 evidence document (e.g. individual stokes_v_leakages sign rows, squint_geometries probe rows, or backend_parity rows beyond what the gate_replay command battery exercises), whose authentication rests on artifact hashing (artifact_authentication) plus a green gate_replay rather than an independent row-by-row rederivation.
